rules.name: quota-service-labels
rules.source: ELb title=a.displayName; DLb label=f.displayName; hla.refreshText=a.description; FLb plan=n=c.userTier.description, q=c.userTier.upgradeSubscriptionText
knownFixedLabelsFromScreenshots: You can upgrade to a Google AI Ultra plan to receive higher rate limits.
rules.handling: Only fixed known UI phrases; preserve literal model names, Google AI Pro/Ultra product names, percentages and all unknown server text. Do not assume the bundle contains all user-facing server labels.

rules.name: quota-refresh-message
rules.observedText: You have used some of your weekly limit, it will fully refresh in 4 days, 19 hours.
rules.secondObservedText: You have used some of your 5-hour limit, it will fully refresh in 1 hour, 56 minutes.
rules.strictPattern: ^You have used some of your (weekly|5-hour) limit, it will fully refresh in ((?:[0-9]+ (?:days?|hours?|minutes?)(?:, )?)+)\.$
rules.output: 你已使用部分{每周|五小时}额度，将在{duration}后完全恢复。
rules.handling: Only use inside settings quota row descriptions or known quota popover. Translate a complete text node, retaining original and applied strings for toggle restoration. Preserve numbers exactly; fail closed on unmatched wording.

rules.name: plan-and-project-id-prefix
rules.handling: Translate only prefix text nodes; preserve sibling server tier label and GCP project ID. Your Plan and Project ID dictionary keys trimmed match these prefixes.

rules.name: settings-static-brand-template
rules.source: Manage ${c} app settings.; When toggled on, ${h} will use ... ${h} will always ...; telemetry and marketing brand templates
rules.handling: Current shipped product.nameShort=Antigravity. Exact composed strings added to settings-candidates. Alternative unknown brand values need bounded repeated capture, never global partial-word replacement.

rules.name: settings-command-keybinding-hints
rules.source: `${e} Sends immediately`; `${e} Queues after the turn`; `${a} On empty prompt, sends next in queue`; `${g} Release`; `${g} Hold`
rules.handling: Preserve keyboard shortcut prefix capture exactly, translate suffix only in keyboard shortcuts/hint scope. Avoid modifying user command strings or input values.

rules.name: admin-disabled-option
rules.handling: Known settings dropdown option: translate known x through dictionary; translate suffix to（管理员已禁用）. Preserve unknown x. Not a global text replacement.

rules.name: project-workspace-kind
rules.handling: All finite project/workspace compositions added as exact dictionary keys. Preserve editable heading project name (W_ span.text-lg.font-medium.truncate), name inputs and user URI suggestions.

rules.name: project-deletion-composite
rules.source: PNb paragraph: 'Are you sure you want to delete the ',h.lowercase,' ',strong(projectName), '?'; second paragraph:'This will permanently delete ',strong(NNb(counts)),' ','within it.'
rules.handling: Dedicated dialog paragraph fragment adapter. Preserve strong(projectName), translate enum type only in confirmed composite layout; NNb count description can use strict numeric template. Do not flatten paragraph.textContent (would destroy strong node and user name).
rules.countPattern: ^([0-9]+) active conversations?(?: and ([0-9]+) archived conversations?)?$|^([0-9]+) archived conversations?$
rules.countOutput: {1} 个活跃对话和 {2} 个已归档对话（only present parts）

fragmentTranslations.This will permanently delete: 此操作将永久删除其中的

rules.name: mcp-tool-count-and-arialabel
rules.source: `${E} tool${E!==1?'s':''} enabled`; `${v.tools.length} tool${v.tools.length!==1?'s':''} disabled`; `Auth code for ${x}`; `${G?'Disable':'Enable'} ${F.name} tool for ${x}`
rules.handling: Count templates can be strict numeric. Attribute templates can preserve complete tool name/server parameter captures, scoped to MCP settings controls. Do not translate dynamic MCP server names/tool identifiers.

rules.name: feedback-email-prefix
rules.handling: Translate only literal prefix. Email sibling remains unchanged.

rules.name: customization-row-user-name-protection
rules.source: rule/skill/plugin name label inside span.text-sm.font-medium.truncate; Plugin: dynamic name; title=`Toggle ${a}`; title=`Edit ${a.name}`
rules.handling: Adding settings-wide div/span scopes requires protecting customization user name rows even when their names match dictionary entries like Default or Models. Do not translate plugin/rule/skill supplied descriptions arbitrarily.

rules.name: unknown-service-and-log-text
rules.handling: Static UI dictionaries do not cover arbitrary gRPC error messages, server descriptions, external MCP metadata, model-generated content or shell output. Leave unknown texts unchanged; report the boundary rather than claiming universal translation.

safetyScopes.settingsRowLabel: .py-2.px-3 .flex-1.flex.flex-col.gap-0\.5 label-like children; include div.text-sm.font-medium and span.text-sm
safetyScopes.portaledHints: role=tooltip and known tooltip IDs only; React tooltip ty has .react-tooltip class/provider
safetyScopes.projectHeadingProtection: W_ span.text-lg.font-medium.truncate, project/global settings breadcrumb dynamic final name, settings-nav project/workspace rows, WSL distro names
